ability.name: Step 2 - Verify Nmap Availability
ability.description: Proves Nmap is available on PATH for fast execution during later stages.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $v=nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String "Nmap"; if($v){ Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true"; Write-Output "recon.nmap_available: true" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false"; Write-Output "recon.nmap_available: false" } } catch { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false"; Write-Output "recon.nmap_available: false" } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step2.txt

rationale: Verifies host availability of Nmap for optimized performance.
